verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general ad-hoc querying and label-based filtering in LogQL. Loki indexes only label metadata. Nothing documents grouping or filtering by high-cardinality fields such as user id or request id without pre-aggregation or index or label definitions, so this applicable analytics axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first
